summary: SCN-pool-bank: architecture's Mucha dressing is built on massed yellow flag irises, but the environment card's seasonal guard bans flag-iris as a spring flower. SCN-riverbank architecture also lists yellow flag irises in the backwater shallows.

findings.value: yellow flag irises and white water-lilies ... massed along the waterline in flowing drifts

conflicts_with.value: water-lilies, loosestrife and meadowsweet flower in July; no spring flag-iris or marsh-marigold

findings.value: yellow flag irises and water-lily pads in the shallows of the backwater
findings.note: SCN-riverbank environment.json has no iris guard, but the waking backwater is the root of the pool bank (cp-pool), so both should agree.

layout_choice: The layout images follow the environment card: water-lilies, purple loosestrife and cream meadowsweet, no flag irises. Irises can be added in shot plates if the ruling goes the other way; no landmark depends on them.
proposed_fix: Decide whether flag irises are allowed for 4 July (Iris pseudacorus flowers roughly May-July, so a late bloom is plausible). Then align either the architecture Mucha dressing or the environment seasonal guard, for both scenes.
not_self_fixed: Per SOUL: setting-card conflicts are reported, not edited by environment-concept.
